versions.changelog:
- Removed the sample file skill-card.md.
- No changes to core functionality or documentation content.

- Added a detailed reference guide covering MCP deployment, protocol, proxy, and path-selection checks.
- Updated the skill description to mention project inspection and troubleshooting capabilities.
- Added license information (MIT) to the manifest.
- Removed the obsolete skill card file.
- Clarified and expanded reference sections in documentation.

Initial release of volcengine-vefaas: a CLI for managing serverless applications on Volcengine veFaaS.

- Deploy and manage serverless applications and functions via command line.
- Supports authentication with SSO or AK/SK, project initialization, deployment, and configuration.
- Includes commands for managing environment variables, viewing domains, and pulling function code.
- Offers global options for debugging, non-interactive usage, and region selection.
- Provides documentation links and cookbooks for common deployment scenarios.
